A '''pirate outpost''' was used by the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]], a faction of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:Second_Battle_of_Florrum_aftermath.png|thumb|left|250px|Ohnaka's base after being razed by General Grievous and his droid army]]
Hondo Ohnaka founded this outpost after escaping from [[Porla/Legends|Porla]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]] with several other servants of Porla.<ref name="ultimateguide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> Ohnaka and his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]] now used the outpost as a base of operations.

The base had a landing area for small transports like [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class attack shuttles]]. It had a market place for outsiders, an area for holding cells with at least one isolation cell equipped with a [[Containment field/Legends|containment field]], a main dining hall/bar, and a storage area for both [[Starhawk speeder bike/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop/Legends|bikes]] and [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|tanks]].<ref name="DC">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref><ref name="TGG">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>

The base was filled with all sorts of listening devices and traps, to make sure no [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] escaped the building.<ref name="ultimateguide" /> The outpost was powered by a long power line of [[Power coupling/Legends|power couplings]], which were destroyed when [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] accidentally rammed one of the pirates [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] into another tank, which then hit the power line and shut down the power grid to the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] base.<ref name="TGG" />

The base was [[Invasion of Florrum/Legends|later]] seized, demolished and discarded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and his forces as retribution for Hondo's ransom of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]],<ref name="A Necessary Bond">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref> however Hondo and his gang would continue to use it in the future.<ref name="Revival">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>
